title: DataPulse MY — Source verification for Malaysian public data
description: A source-verification layer for AI agents using Malaysian public data.

hero.heading: Verify Malaysian data before your AI agent uses it.
hero.copy: DataPulse records observed source identity, freshness, provenance, licence and reuse context, structural evidence, and limitations so people and agents can make an evidence-qualified decision alongside the official publisher.

receipt_preview.label: Live published evidence from health/latest.json
receipt_preview.copy: These are real observed values from the published health snapshot and dataset manifest; any unobserved signal is shown as 'not observed' rather than a fabricated value.

rails.name: Readable
rails.copy: Concise human and machine-readable dataset context.

rails.name: Discoverable
rails.copy: Canonical discovery files and a public catalogue.

rails.name: Callable
rails.copy: Read-only MCP access to structured public-data context.

rails.name: Verifiable
rails.copy: Observed freshness, provenance, licence, structural evidence, drift, reconciliation, and limitations.

rails.name: Payable
rails.copy: Future and conditional: no payment product is offered on this surface.

boundaries: DataPulse is read-only; official publishers remain the source of record.
Integrity, provenance, freshness, and structural checks do not establish substantive truth.
Unknown, stale, degraded, inaccessible, and conflicting signals remain visible.
Agents and humans decide whether the available evidence is fit for a particular use.

vertical.label: See the NPRA example
vertical.copy: Domain products can sit downstream of this public source-verification layer without replacing its evidence boundaries.
